releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 4 - 1.1.2

- FIXED: the game could crash on startup if your save was already on the Highland Isle.
- THE OLD MINE is open: it moved to the mountainside west of Basecamp, and you can walk inside. Follow the rails through the tunnels and press F on glowing ore veins for Stone, Copper, Iron, Gold and Crystal. Veins grow back every day.
- A new Arrivals dock where you land on the Highland Isle. The Rebirth Ferry moved to the north shore, on the far side of the island.
- Signs now read the right way from both sides.
- Relic Piece 5 now hides deep inside the Old Mine.
